title: netpack manifest (SimCity 3000 network mod package)
description: One folder per package; this is its manifest.json. Guide: re/analysis/NETPACK.md. Tool: re/tools/netmod/netpack.py.

name.description: Unique package name; also its folder under mods\netmod\packs and its variant table name.

game.description: Anchors: game-root-relative path -> sha256 of the stock file the package was made against. install and validate refuse a tree whose file differs.

rule_edits.description: TilingRules edits, format agreed with the netrules session (re/tools/netmod/netpack_rules.py). Indexes are 0-based in the STOCK file.

bridges.description: Task netbridge: records of <NET>_GRND_Bridges.txt (ROAD, RAIL, HWAY, POWR). Road/rail/power builders take the FIRST record whose axis matches and min_len <= the crossing length; the highway builder takes the first whose axis (0..3, two lanes) matches. Indexes are 0-based in the STOCK file.

crossings.description: Task netbridge: crossing art for variants (sc3netmod.dll XCROSS). When the existing piece is `over`, the crossing the matrix gives (`crossing`) is built as `piece`, a variant of that crossing.

ramps.description: Hardcoded SIMNTWRK piece tables (on-ramps, tunnels, slope pieces): which piece a table slot places. netramp.py tables lists every table and slot. Guide: re/analysis/NET_RAMPS.md.

lanes.description: Task lanekit: street-sim lane graphs (TrBlkAtt) for a variant or stock piece, written in lanekit's authoring format (re/tools/netmod/lanekit.py, guide re/analysis/NET_LANES.md). Records for every language folder; English-UK gets the mirrored lanes unless the spec says mirror_uk false.

connects.description: Task lanekit: turn matrices (exemplar props 310 road / 311 rail / 312 subway): which (entry side, exit side) pairs a piece connects. Read by the tiler (final stage) and by the SimTransit router for highway and bus nodes. low = ENGLISH-side lanes, high = English-UK-side lanes; a plain list sets both.

templates.description: Multi-cell templates the player places in one click (task multitile): a fixed block of pieces that keeps its cells (Protected list) and connects to the networks around it. Guide: re/analysis/MULTITILE.md.

piece.description: A ROAD variant of T 39 declared in this package, with art and lanes for the pinwheel states 3,0 / 2,1.

min_arms.description: Exits (one per block side) that must hold a single road.

closed_piece.description: Task roundabout4: another ROAD variant of T 39 in this package, placed (same state) on the quarter whose exit holds no road; art and lanes for a quarter without an arm. Absent: every quarter is `piece`.

auto_roundabouts.description: Task roundabout3: sc3netmod turns every qualifying 2x2 road block into this piece by itself (after each road retile and after a city load) and back into stock road when it stops qualifying. Rule: re/analysis/MULTITILE.md section 5. One piece across all installed packages.

centre.description: The centre cell (the island), a ROAD variant in this package.

side.description: The side-middle cell at state 0 (the E cell, outer side x+) by its arm: none, road, avenue half with the median toward z-, toward z+.

corner.description: The corner cell at state 0 (the NE cell, outer sides z- and x+), index 3 * kN + kE by the arm on z- (kN) and on x+ (kE): 0 none, 1 road, 2 avenue half.

auto_big_roundabouts.description: Task bigrbt: sc3netmod (RBT9 block) turns every exactly-3x3 road block with arms (at most two per side: one avenue or up to two single roads, no road on the four diagonal cells) into a big roundabout made of these pieces, after each road retile and after a city load, and back into stock road when it stops qualifying. Rule and tool: re/tools/netmod/bigrbt.py, verify/bigrbt/.

cells.description: Task bvlanes (auto_boulevard_junctions only): box cells chosen by real box width, height, sides N E S W (A arm / C closed) and cell i j from its x- z- corner -> piece and state (bvlanes.py build). Present: the edge patterns no longer choose the cells.

piece.description: A ROAD variant in this package: one cell of the paved box, drawn at state 0 with these edges.

edges.description: The cell's edges N E S W at state 0: I another box cell, A an arm cell (crosswalk), C closed (curb). Each pattern serves all four rotations.

save_11204.description: Save the cell as stock 11204 in its own state (a T's far half; needs the closed edge on S).

piece.description: A ROAD variant of 11204 in this package: the avenue cell beside the box, its median ending in a concrete nose.

nose.description: The end of the 11204 half (state 0: median N, outer sidewalk S) that faces the box.

auto_avenue_junctions.description: Task avx: sc3netmod's AVX block re-pieces straight avenue intersections (avenue x avenue, avenue T, road x avenue, road T) as one paved box after each road retile and after a city load. Rule: re/tools/netmod/avx.py. One set across all installed packages.

piece.description: A ROAD variant in this package drawn as road 29 (orientation `road`) with the avenue's 35 halves (states `halves`) over it as asphalt, at state 0.

halves.description: States of the stock 35 halves the junction cell holds (one at the avenue's edge, two in its middle).

road.description: The crossing road: 0 along x, 1 along z (road 29's state).

far.description: A stem (the avenue ends on the road): the curb kept on the far side, 0 N 1 E 2 S 3 W; -1 none.

junction.description: Task diagave: junction pieces where a straight road crosses the avenue, meets it from one side, or the avenue ends on it. Each one serves its descriptor in all four rotations.

axis.description: 0 the down-right diagonal, 1 the other one (x mirrored).

end.description: 0: the band's last row, the single road goes on down; 1: its first row, going on up.

cont.description: The staircase that goes on as a single road.

cells.description: [dx, dz, piece, state]: the cell dx, dz from the end row's left cell (axis space) gets a ROAD variant of this package at that state.

merge.description: Task diagave: merge cases, where one carriageway ends and the other goes on as a single road (diagave.py MERGE_TABLE).

save_43.description: Merge pieces that hold both roads: saved as 43 so a game without the mod keeps the road joined.

axis.description: The axis of the band row the template is anchored on.

grid.description: The window, w x h cells from (x0, z0) relative to the anchor row's left cell in axis space, row by row: r ROAD, . no ROAD, - either.

partner.description: [axis, dx, dz]: the window holds a band of that axis (a row's left cell at dx, dz) that must convert too; axis -1 none.

writes.description: [dx, dz, piece, state]: a cell the crossing writes (a ROAD variant of this package, or stock road such as 11204).

crossing.description: Task diagx: crossing templates of a diagonal avenue with a diagonal avenue or the straight avenue 11204, or ending on one (diagave.py xbuild, recipe_crossings.json).

piece.description: A ROAD variant of stock piece `a` in this package: piece a at the cell's state plus piece b at state + delta on one tile, with both pieces' lanes.

a.description: Staircase A's piece in the shared cell (35 diagonal, 18004 start cap, 1999 end cap).

b.description: Staircase B's piece in the shared cell; 0 = the OUTER piece (a 35, delta 0): a one-road 35 cell beside the other road, with its median-side sidewalk tip as median.

delta.description: B's state minus A's state, mod 4.

auto_diagonal_avenues.description: Task diagave: sc3netmod turns two diagonal road drags JOINED side by side (an isolated band of rows of three road cells, each row shifted by one) into one avenue: each cell gets the piece the stock tiler gives a lone diagonal, and the middle cells, which hold both roads, get the declared middle piece. After each road retile and after a city load; back to stock when it stops qualifying. Rule and tool: re/tools/netmod/diagave.py, verify/diagave/.

auto_boulevard_junctions.description: Task bvx: box and avenue-arm pieces for the junctions of a boulevard (auto_boulevards) with avenues and other boulevards, same shape as auto_avenue_junctions (save_11204 unused). sc3netmod places them inside the boulevard runs. Rule and tool: re/tools/netmod/bvx.py, verify/bvx/.

group.description: string table group, e.g. "0x029541F4" (SC3StringsWindow, the dialog texts)

id.description: instance id inside the group (pick one no stock container uses)

text.description: one string, or {language folder or "*": text}

texts.description: Task hwask: free-standing strings {0x2026960B, group, id}, written per Apps\Res\Text\<folder> into SC3StringsNetpack_<group>.IXF and listed in SYS.PAK Default.ini [DBSegments] under the group's key. Identical entries in two packages merge; different ones are an error.

highway_lines.description: Task hwcore: raw sc3netmod table lines of the highway program (sc3netmod_hwy.c and the shape blocks on it): `hwyp <piece> <land 0|1> [<save id>]` declares a piece, `hwyt <A> <B>` the hwcore proof rule; each shape stream adds its own keyword (hwx, hwt, hwdx, hwdd). Pieces named in hwyp must be HWAY variants of this package.

avenue_lines.description: Task avcore: raw sc3netmod table lines of the one-way avenue base (sc3netmod_avl.c, re/analysis/AVENUE_LANES.md): `avls <piece>` the one-way straight half, `avlu <piece>` the end U-turn quarter, `avlc <piece> <base> <side>` a one-way crossing / slope variant whose lanes run toward world side <side> (0 N 1 E 2 S 3 W) at state 0, `avlj <piece> <NESW>` a sibling piece a one-way band may end on (I = traffic enters the piece across that side, O = leaves, . = none, at state 0). Pieces must be ROAD variants of this package.

band.description: Band pieces: the outer cell (canonical d3 at state 0; d0 = state 2) and the inner cell (d2 at state 0; d1 = state 2).

stamps.description: Per junction / end kind, the cells it writes: [dx, dz, piece, state] in its canonical frame (diagbv.py: row family relative to a band row's left cell, column family relative to the column road's d0 cell). Pieces are variants of this package, or 29 / 35.

auto_diagonal_boulevards.description: Task diagbv: sc3netmod turns three diagonal road drags joined side by side (rows of four road cells, each row shifted by one) into one 3-wide diagonal boulevard, with its junctions, ends and bends (re/tools/netmod/diagbv.py, verify/diagbv/). Its cells are claimed before the DAV and BV blocks run.

outer.description: An outer row (carriageway + its extra lane), canonical south row at state 0.

middle.description: The middle row: the extra lanes' far parts, curbs, median, trees.

nose.description: Middle row whose median ends in a nose at +x (state 0).

nose2.description: Middle row with a nose at both ends.

junction_entry.description: Junction column, the outer row a crossing road enters by (north row at state 0).

junction_far.description: Junction column, the far outer row of a T (south row at state 0, closed side S).

cap.description: End column where all three roads stop, rows 0 / 1 / 2 at the +x end (state 0).

taper.description: Narrowing to row 0 / 1 / 2: nine pieces, column-major (3 * column + row), the last three columns at the +x end (state 0).

junction_t.description: Task bvlanes: a T junction's entry row and middle row (their one-way lanes differ from a crossing's); the middle row is placed at state 2 for a T from +w.

avenue_narrow.description: Narrowing to the avenue on rows k, k + 1 (key k = 0 / 1): nine pieces, column-major, the last three columns at the +x end (state 0).

auto_boulevards.description: Task boulevard: sc3netmod turns three parallel straight roads (a run of at least 3 clean columns, along x or z) into one boulevard: carriageways on the outer rows, extra lanes and a tree median on the middle one; junctions with single straight roads, end caps and tapers. After each road retile and after a city load; back to stock when it stops qualifying. Rule and tool: re/tools/netmod/boulevard.py, verify/boulevard/.

art.description: Start from the frames of piece `from` (variants: default = base; reskins: always the piece itself), optionally recolour them, then replace any frame that has a PNG in png_dir (file names zZ_rR.png, layer > 0: lL_zZ_rR.png; same size as the frame, or any size with its registration point in png_dir/anchors.json) or that a compose recipe builds.

first_pass.description: artkit: set (true) or clear (false) the frame table's first-pass draw bit (header +0x12, 0x80). Road pieces ship it set: they draw before every other occupant, so art taller than the base frame gets its top overdrawn in some rotations. Clear it for pieces with tall props. NET_ART.md 8.

ground_under.description: roundabout4: set (true) or clear (false) the frame table's ground bit (header +0x12, 0x40). With it set the engine draws the cell's terrain under the piece (SIMSPR 0x100192aa -> 0x1001a303), so transparent pixels show grass; curve 11203 ships it set, road 29 and T 39 do not (their transparent pixels show the previous frame). NET_ART.md 11.

recipe.description: artkit: a netart.py compose recipe (JSON) in the package; the frames are composed from the stock install at build time into a png_dir (both may not be given). NET_ART.md 6.

names.description: Piece name: one string for every language folder, or {folder or "*": text} (folders of Apps\Res\Text; the Spanish GOG install keeps Spanish in ENGLISH).

id.description: New piece id: no stock exemplar, not 15130..15141.

base.description: Stock piece the variant behaves as (exemplar, cost, traffic, crossings, the id written to saves).

inherit.description: Task netbridge: the variant joins every Set, DIAG_Set and Protected list that holds the base, and gets Convert / Complex_Convert rows (variant, s) -> what the base reads as, so rule conditions that test for the base also match it (re/analysis/NETBRIDGE.md).

replace_base.description: Task netbridge: every RESULT that places the base in the variant's network's stage rule files places the variant instead (one set_results edit per rule, generated at install).

rule.description: 0-based index into the STOCK file's rules

oneOf.description: 0-based index into the STOCK file's rules

rule.description: 0-based index into the STOCK file's rules

ini_edit.description: A key inside a SYS.PAK member (the archive wins over loose files, SC3U 0x004872e8). set = change an existing key, add = a new key at the end of the section.

op.description: set = change the one existing key; add = new key, refused if it exists; append = add the line even if the key exists (list sections such as [DBSegments])

piece_state.description: [id, state]: id 1..65535 with state 0..3, or id 0 with state 5 (empty), 1 (pending), 0 (foreign).

record.description: [dir, id, state]: dir 0..23 (5x5 neighbourhood table, SIMNTWRK 0x10032134) or 255 (the tile itself).

axis.description: Road/rail/power: 0 = run along x, 1 = along z. Highway: 0..3, one record per lane (0/2 x run, 3/1 z run).

min_len.description: Road/rail/power: the record is a candidate when the crossing length L >= min_len. The highway builder never reads it.

a.description: Start ramp, A[0] at position -1 (5-slot stack buffer).

b.description: Pad, B[0] repeated (r >> 1) times, r = L - k * len(span).

span.description: The span, repeated k = L // len(span) times (20-slot stack buffer).

e.description: End ramp, E[0] at position L.

at.description: insert: before stock record N, or start / end.

record.description: insert: the new record. delete: the stock record index.

piece_tok.description: Task netbridge: a bridge list entry [piece id, state 0..3] (file value id << 8 | state).

from.description: Stock piece id (every slot holding it, state kept) or [id, state] (one slot).

to.description: A variant whose base is the from id (keep its inherit on), or a stock piece in the same Set files.

spec.description: lanekit spec: a file in the package folder or inline.

oneOf.description: a hole: the cell is not part of the template

size.description: [W, H]: W cells along x, H along z

rows.description: H rows (z = 0..H-1), each W cells (x = 0..W-1), base orientation

edges.description: The exits (arms pointing out of the footprint). Omitted: every outward arm, optional.

collapse.description: true (default): the package's template pieces form one Collapse.txt group, so removing one cell removes the template (and any template of the same package touching it)
